fields.Name: W1 -> S5.5
fields.Description: Gate G1.10 (phase 1, dataset W1, criterion S5.5): the W1-signal s42 snapshot's row manifest holds 16,776 rows, the content hash recomputed from the stored matrix matches (1 of 1), and a retrain from the snapshot and logged configuration reproduces the holdout metric within 1e-9. It fails when the retrain request's logged hyperparameters change (the recorded mutation sets C to 0.001), so the retrained holdout metrics differ by more than 1e-9, or when the retrainer cannot verify the content hash. The logged seed is not a mutation target: the sidecar's random_state drives only its internal validation split, never the model that scores the locked holdout.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The W1 snapshot manifest holds 16,776 rows, its content hash recomputes from the stored files and the retrainer verifies it, and a retrain from the snapshot with the logged configuration reproduces the holdout metrics within 1e-9.
